prompt: Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Composition: Chronological entries with dates on a shared rail, compact media, explicit sequence. Use body 20px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 60ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1440px and item radius 8px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
